Jared: FYI invoice RWI-4762 came through for $250,500 prepaid Dedicated (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31) but the billing export split $250,500 into 12 equal months except our contract indicates a June start. Looks like the invoice generation used calendar-year allocation rather than contract start.
Maya: That will misstate Q1 vs Q2 revenue. Contract is START=2026-06-01 END=2027-05-31. Should be deferred 12 months starting June.
AP-team: Best fix is to post reversing JE and apply a custom revenue schedule starting 2026-06-01.
rev-bot: Ticket #RWI-ACC-922 opened for manual revenue schedule.
Jared: Noting this one will require cross-team coordination (Billing Eng + Sales Ops + Accounting) since invoice generator is using invoice_date for allocation.
Maya: I'll coordinate with Sales Ops to fix the contract meta on the invoice and ask Billing Eng to push a mapping rule change.
AP-team: Draft JE we want posted on 2026-01-31 (reverse mis-post):
DR Sales Revenue (GL 4001): 250,500
CR Deferred Revenue (GL 2190): 250,500
Then schedule recognition DR 2190 / CR 4001 monthly 20,875 for Jun 2026 - May 2027.
Jared: Approvals required: > $250k threshold? it's $250.5k so needs CFO sign-off per policy.
Maya: On it, I'll loop in CFO and add the rationale.
rev-bot: Note: Pending CFO approval for manual reclassification.
